name: Joovy Twin Roo+ Car Seat Stroller

notes: A car-seat carrier frame for TWINS — it has no seats of its own; it mounts two infant car seats side-by-side (each can face either direction). Requires brand-specific adapters (sold separately); the Clek Liing (Maxi-Cosi footprint) uses the Maxi-Cosi/Cybex Twin Roo+ adapter (adapter-joovy-twinroo-mcn). Max 35 lb per car seat.
